newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end up higher on firmer Dow.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end up higher on firmer Dow.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed up 0.36 percent in higher turnover, helped by gains on Wall Street after a weaker-than-expected U.S. March consumer price index (CPI) eased inflation fears, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most traded shares ended at 9,490 points. Volume returned to recent average levels and totalled 609.02 million reais ($574.7 million).
"It was pretty much New York behind the market's rise today," a trader said.

Traders said the Bovespa index was even higher earlier, rising over one percent, but the market trimmed gains late in the day on speculation ahead of the mid-April futures index and options settlement.
They noted that selling pressure from players holding short positions in the optios market helped to reduce the market's strength.
The options will settle on April 22, while the futures index contracts will be liquidated Wednesday.
